title: A ladder and a broken fence
context: You will hear two next-door neighbours in Maple Ridge talking on a Saturday morning.

segments.speaker: Dave
segments.text: Morning, Gurpreet! Sorry to bug you on a Saturday. I was wondering if I could borrow your extension ladder again? My gutters are full of needles from that big cedar.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet
segments.text: Oh, hi Dave. Sure, of course. It's in the garage. Just bring it back by Monday, though. Raj needs it to fix the light over our deck.

segments.speaker: Dave
segments.text: Monday, no problem. I'll probably have it back tomorrow. Actually, while I've got you, have you seen the fence? The back section, behind the shed?

segments.speaker: Gurpreet
segments.text: I have. That windstorm on Wednesday really did a number on it. Two of the posts are basically leaning on my rhododendrons.

segments.speaker: Dave
segments.text: Yeah. So I got a quote from Fraser Fencing. They want twenty-four hundred to replace that whole back section. Split down the middle, that's twelve hundred each.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet
segments.text: Twelve hundred. Hmm. That's more than I was expecting, to be honest.

segments.speaker: Dave
segments.text: Me too. Which is why I had another idea. My brother-in-law, Kyle, does this kind of thing on weekends. He says he'd do it for the cost of materials, maybe nine hundred total.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet
segments.text: That's a lot cheaper. But, um, is he actually a fence builder? I don't want to be doing this again in two years.

segments.speaker: Dave
segments.text: Well, he's a carpenter. He built his own deck, and it's held up fine.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet
segments.text: I'm sure he's great. It's just, Fraser Fencing gives a warranty, right? If Kyle's posts rot, who do we call?

segments.speaker: Dave
segments.text: Yeah, ten years. Fair enough, that's a good point.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet
segments.text: How about this? Let's get one more quote from a proper company. If it's close to Kyle's price, we go with the company. If not, well, maybe Kyle.

segments.speaker: Dave
segments.text: Okay, I can live with that. I'll call around on Monday. And look, if money's tight right now, I don't mind covering the whole thing first. You can pay me back later.

segments.speaker: Gurpreet
segments.text: That's kind of you, but it's fine. We'll pay our share when the work's done.

questions.prompt: Why does Dave want to borrow the ladder?

options.text: To fix a light over his deck.
options.whyVi: Raj (người nhà của Gurpreet) mới là người cần sửa đèn trên sân sau.

options.text: To clear plant debris out of his gutters.
options.whyVi: Đúng: máng xối đầy lá kim từ cây tuyết tùng.

options.text: To repair the damaged fence.
options.whyVi: Hàng rào là chủ đề sau, không phải lý do mượn thang.

options.text: To cut branches off the cedar tree.
options.whyVi: 'Cedar' có được nhắc nhưng Dave không nói sẽ tỉa cây.

questions.evidence: My gutters are full of needles from that big cedar.
questions.explanationVi: 'Gutters are full of needles' ngụ ý anh cần dọn máng xối. 'Needles' (lá kim) được diễn đạt chung thành 'plant debris'.

questions.prompt: By when does Gurpreet need the ladder returned?

options.text: By Sunday.
options.whyVi: Dave nói anh 'probably' trả vào ngày mai (Chủ nhật), nhưng Gurpreet yêu cầu trước thứ Hai.

options.text: By Wednesday.
options.whyVi: Thứ Tư là ngày có bão gió.

options.text: By Saturday evening.
options.whyVi: Hôm nay là thứ Bảy; không ai yêu cầu trả trong tối nay.

options.text: No later than Monday.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'Just bring it back by Monday'.

questions.evidence: Just bring it back by Monday, though.
questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi hỏi Gurpreet CẦN khi nào: 'bring it back by Monday'. Dave nói 'tomorrow' chỉ là dự định của anh.

questions.prompt: How does Gurpreet feel about the first quote?

options.text: She thinks it is a fair price.
options.whyVi: Cô nói giá cao hơn cô nghĩ.

options.text: She finds it higher than she had expected.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'That's more than I was expecting, to be honest'.

options.text: She refuses to pay any part of it.
options.whyVi: Cô thấy đắt nhưng không từ chối trả; cuối bài cô nói sẽ trả phần của mình.

options.text: She thinks Dave should pay more than half.
options.whyVi: Không ai đề nghị Dave trả nhiều hơn một nửa.

questions.evidence: That's more than I was expecting, to be honest.
questions.explanationVi: 'Hmm' và 'more than I was expecting' thể hiện sự bất ngờ vì giá cao. Đáp án B là cách nói lại.

questions.prompt: What is Gurpreet's main concern about having Kyle do the work?

options.text: There would be no guarantee if the fence failed.
options.whyVi: Đúng: công ty có bảo hành, còn nếu cột của Kyle mục thì 'who do we call?'.

options.text: He would charge more than Fraser Fencing.
options.whyVi: Kyle rẻ hơn nhiều (khoảng 900 đô).

options.text: He might damage her rhododendrons.
options.whyVi: Hoa đỗ quyên bị cột hàng rào đổ đè vì bão, không liên quan tới Kyle.

options.text: He only works on weekends.
options.whyVi: Dave có nói Kyle làm vào cuối tuần, nhưng Gurpreet không lo về điều này.

questions.evidence: If Kyle's posts rot, who do we call?
questions.explanationVi: Gurpreet so sánh: công ty có 'warranty' 10 năm, còn Kyle thì không – 'who do we call?'. 'Warranty' = 'guarantee'.

questions.prompt: What do the neighbours finally agree to do?

options.text: Hire Kyle because his price is much lower.
options.whyVi: Kyle chỉ được chọn NẾU báo giá thứ hai không gần với giá của anh.

options.text: Book Fraser Fencing on Monday.
options.whyVi: Dave sẽ gọi vào thứ Hai để xin thêm báo giá, không phải đặt Fraser Fencing.

options.text: Compare another professional estimate before deciding.
options.whyVi: Đúng: xin thêm một báo giá từ công ty chuyên nghiệp rồi mới quyết.

options.text: Let Dave pay the whole cost first.
options.whyVi: Dave đề nghị nhưng Gurpreet từ chối: 'That's kind of you, but it's fine'.

questions.evidence: Let's get one more quote from a proper company.
questions.explanationVi: Gurpreet đề xuất và Dave đồng ý ('I can live with that'). 'One more quote from a proper company' = 'another professional estimate'.

vocabulary.definition: an informal way to say something damaged or hurt something badly

vocabulary.definition: a statement of how much a job will cost
vocabulary.example: Let's get one more quote from a proper company.

vocabulary.definition: to divide a cost equally between two people

review.notes: Blind-solved all 5 Qs; key matched. Distractors (Sunday vs Monday, Kyle vs second quote) checked for single defensible answer. Changed only Q1 option A whyVi, which asserted Raj is Gurpreet's husband (not stated).
